# ghost/africa-quiz

Africa Quiz (F-Droid): a 10 question quiz on the capitals of African countries. Start a round, read and answer questions, then read the score and the answer review. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/africa-quiz
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/africa-quiz start_quiz --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/africa-quiz get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/africa-quiz answer --device <serial> --param option=<option>
ghost skill run ghost/africa-quiz answer_many --device <serial> --param options=<options>
ghost skill run ghost/africa-quiz get_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `start_quiz`: Start the Africa capitals quiz
- `get_question`: What is the current Africa quiz question?
- `answer`: Answer Kigali in the Africa quiz
- `answer_many`: Answer the next three Africa quiz questions with options 1, 1 and 2
- `get_results`: Show the Africa quiz results
